title: Achillea millefolium tea for medicinal use
intro: Achillea millefolium tea is a herbal preparation made from the dried leaves and flowers of the yarrow plant. It has been used for centuries in traditional herbalism for its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and astringent properties. This tea is commonly used to support digestive health, reduce bleeding, and soothe skin irritations. It may also help alleviate symptoms of colds and respiratory infections. In herbal medicine, it is often prepared as a tincture or infused tea to harness its therapeutic benefits.
